999008199.text: それはそうと、楽しんでいますこと？

localizations.en: By the way, are you enjoying yourself?

999008199.text: ええ。こんなに心が躍るのは久しぶりよ

localizations.en: Indeed. It's been quite some time since my heart has raced like this.

999008199.text:
それならば良いのです。あなたを楽しませることが
できているのであれば大抵の方は楽しめるでしょうから

localizations.en: Well, that's good to hear. If I can entertain someone like you, then most people should be able to enjoy themselves.

999008199.text: ふふふ……引き続き楽しませてもらうわ

localizations.en: Hehehe... I'll continue to let you entertain me.

999008199.text:
……やはり怪しいですわね。
今すぐに追い出すべきでしょうか

localizations.en: ...She's definitely suspicious. Perhaps I should have her removed immediately.
